400.body: Dentons advised European Energy, a leading international developer of renewable energy projects headquartered in Denmark, on the sale of the 21 MW Myślibórz onshore wind project to TAURON, a leading Polish state-backed energy group. The divestment of projects at various stages of development and operation allows European Energy to reinvest capital in its growing pipeline of renewable energy projects.
